notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41318875/379cdd1b814a11b4805ea6499a0c98a6cbf11217.png[/img]

Official release date-
We are excited to announce that “Robolife2-Nova Duty” will be released on Steam platform at 6:30pm 10th March (PST). 

Bonus from the prequel-
If you have “Robolife-Days with Aino” save data on your Steam account. Player will be able to unlock special head gear for Nova at the beginning of the game. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41318875/1f310e2729048e2e0fcd3c5553ed1b89ca7109e4.jpg[/img]

Original Soundtrack-
Original soundtrack for “Robolife2 – Nova Duty” will also be released on Steam at the same time with the release of the game.
